_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Friday W17 closes heaviest single week in 2026 AI to date with four-track headline: capital, China, frontier, sovereignty. (1) Google to invest up to $40B in Anthropic: $10B cash now at $350B + $30B contingent + 5GW Google Cloud over 5 years. Combined with Monday's Amazon $5B+$20B / 5GW + Tuesday's Anthropic-Google-Broadcom 3.5GW TPU = Anthropic has now disclosed ~$45B+ in committed equity capital and 8.5GW+ multi-cloud compute in a single week — largest single-company capital + capacity mobilisation in tech history. Motley Fool calls $350B 'a screaming bargain' against $850–900B preemptive offers floating. (2) DeepSeek V4 Preview — V4 Pro (1.6T total / 49B active MoE) + V4 Flash (284B total / 13B active MoE), 1M-token context, top-tier coding, major reasoning/agentic gains; pricing $0.14/$0.28 (Flash) + $0.145/$3.48 (Pro) per 1M — undercut Gemini/GPT/Claude ~10× on cheap end. DeepSeek paired with Huawei 'Supernode' technology clustering Ascend 950 chips — most explicit demonstration that export-control regimes are being routed around; Anthropic + OpenAI accuse DeepSeek of model distillation; OSTP Director Michael Kratsios calls out 'industrial-scale distillation' of US frontier models. (3) GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.5 Pro hit the API with system card finalised; doubled per-token pricing ($5/$30; Pro flat $30/$180) — first frontier-lab disclosure to include separate API vs ChatGPT evaluation gates. (4) Cohere acquires Aleph Alpha — $20B 'transatlantic AI powerhouse' (Cohere ~90% / Aleph Alpha ~10%; Schwarz Group +$600M Series E; dual HQs Toronto + Germany; Germany Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger + Canada AI Minister Evan Solomon endorse as 'sovereign AI' alternative). Largest non-US AI consolidation of 2026. (5) Anthropic + M365 Copilot deepens — Opus 4.7 primary reasoning option + finance add-ins in private beta ahead of 6-9 May Excel/PowerPoint/Word GA. Anthropic now has formal alliances with every major hyperscaler. (6) Cooley state-AI-laws tracker — California foundation-model + New York agent-disclosure as most-cited 2026 H1 enactments. (7) Amazon custom silicon $20B+ annual run rate >100% YoY. (8) Snap ~1,000 layoffs — 65%+ new code AI-generated. Best long-form: Anthropic April 23 postmortem (Willison-annotated, standout = March 26 thinking-context-clear bug fired every turn after 1h idle — required reading on harness engineering); SemiAnalysis 'Coding Assistant Breakdown' — true blended Opus 4.7 ~$0.99 per Mtok despite $5/$25 sticker; Nilay Patel 'The people do not yearn for automation'. Research: VLAA-GUI termination/recovery/re-search GUI primitives, Co-Evolving Decision + Skill Bank for long-horizon, WorldMark interactive video world-models, WebGen-R1 functional+aesthetic websites RL, DAVinCI dual attribution + verification, Hybrid Policy Distillation, 3D-VCD embodied-agent hallucination mitigation. STAGE MOVES: lab-services-gtm + compute-economics-thesis crescendo on Google $40B + DeepSeek V4 + Cohere/Aleph Alpha; new 'Sovereign AI consolidation' topic on Cohere × Aleph Alpha; 'DeepSeek V4 + export-control routing' emerges.
